# Qingzhou Store verification integration

Adapted from mengangs/ipadn at 1ff9656c856cb29421a11e3de4816eee3251027a. Original component attribution and license limitations are preserved in ORIGINAL-NOTICES.md and PROVENANCE.json. Runtime assets other than index.html are unchanged; index.html adds a same-origin Content Security Policy. The derived combined iOS application is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later; corresponding source is in the public ios-livecontainer branch and release source archive. Original MIT notices for ipatool and other dependencies remain applicable to those components.

Only device identifiers, challenges and proof state enter this runtime; Apple passwords and session cookies stay outside it. No paid-app license bypass is implemented.
